title: I put 100 rabbits on an island. Then I added 10 foxes. 🦊 #shorts
description:
100 rabbits. 10 foxes. One island. A real simulation: every hunt, birth and starvation happens on its own. Who should I add next?

Sub goal: every 10 subs = a new species on the island.

#simulation #ecosystem #foxes #rabbits #shorts
